subject: alchemist_unstable_concoction

definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）

调制的时间越久，伤害越大，眩晕时间也越长。

炼金术士调制一瓶不稳定的化合物，投向敌方英雄，对爆炸点周边范围的单位造成伤害并眩晕。
调制%brew_time%秒后达到最大伤害量和最长眩晕时间。

context.description_en: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After %brew_time% seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after %brew_explosion% seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
context.description_zh: 炼金术士调制一瓶不稳定的化合物，投向敌方英雄，对爆炸点周边范围的单位造成伤害并眩晕。调制的时间越久，伤害越大，眩晕时间也越长。炼金术士在调制期间获得移动速度加成。调制%brew_time%秒后达到最大伤害量和最长眩晕时间。然而，若%brew_explosion%秒后未扔出药剂，则会在炼金术士自己手中爆炸。
notes_en: While brewing, this ability is replaced by Unstable Concoction Throw.  Alchemist can move and act normally while brewing.
A timer above Alchemist's head will indicate the remaining brew time. This timer is visible to enemies.
You can deny yourself with this skill.
Unstable Concoction cannot be disjointed and once thrown Unstable Concoction stops brewing.
Unstable Concoction explosion damages heroes and creeps.
notes_zh: 摇制开始后，本技能替换为投掷不稳定化合物。炼金术士在摇制期间可以像平常一样移动和攻击。
炼金术士的头顶会有倒计时，提示剩余的摇制时间。倒计时对敌人可见。
可以用此技能将自己反补。
不稳定化合物无法被躲避，并且不稳定化合物被掷出后会停止调制。
不稳定化合物的爆炸会对英雄和非英雄单位造成伤害。

context.description_en: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
context.description_zh: 向地图的任意位置发出爆炸冰球，在冰球飞行时再次施放此技能将使其停下，使所在区域产生毁灭性的冰爆。冰球飞行的距离越长，冰爆影响的范围也将越大。冰爆范围内的所有敌方单位将马上受到大量伤害，而处于冰球飞行路径上的敌方英雄将与冰爆范围内的敌方英雄一同受到寒霜诅咒的作用，持续受到小幅伤害，同时无法恢复生命值。在此期间如果生命值低于一定百分比，该英雄将立刻死亡。
notes_en: Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
The area of effect is %radius_min% + %radius_grow%*TimeTraveled, capped at %radius_max%.
Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.
notes_zh: 施放后本技能替换为释放，将使指向球停在目标区域。
作用范围的大小是%radius_min% + %radius_grow%*指向球的飞行时间，上限为%radius_max%。
击杀目标的英雄由触发即死的伤害来源决定。
斩杀效果对幻象无效。
寒霜诅咒的负面状态无法被驱散，包括身处泉水附近，但魂断、时光倒流和超新星除外。

shard_loc.en: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for %cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%% of the duration.
shard_loc.zh: 冻结击中的敌人，持续时间为当前等级寒霜之足眩晕时间的%cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%%。

context.description_en: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a %delay%s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing %damage% + %damage_str%%% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
context.description_zh: 大地之灵化身为巨石，经过%delay%秒延迟后向目标位置翻滚，对经过的敌人造成伤害和眩晕，伤害值为%damage% + %damage_str%%%力量。如果撞到敌方英雄或自身被眩晕，翻滚都会中止。如果翻滚过程中经过残岩将会大幅提高翻滚距离和速度，造成的眩晕时间更长。
notes_en: Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
The boulder has a radius of %radius%.
Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.
notes_zh: 翻滚时经过残岩会将其摧毁。
巨石的作用范围为%radius%。
大地之灵在滚动时无法作为目标，而且无敌。

subject: earthshaker_fissure
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成眩晕的时间有所降低。
Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.

context.description_en: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
context.description_zh: 用威武的图腾猛击地面，沿直线裂开地面，制造一条无法通过的岩脊，对沿途的敌方单位造成眩晕和伤害。
notes_en: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
notes_zh: 小兵将会等待沟壑消失，不会去尝试绕开它。
沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。

shard_loc.en: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.

subject: grimstroke_spirit_walk
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: %buff_duration%秒后将根据墨须对英雄造成伤害的时间对区域内单位造成伤害和眩晕。
After %buff_duration% seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.

context.description_en: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After %buff_duration% seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
context.description_zh: 天涯墨客将一个友方单位笼罩在一片墨汁中，目标的移动速度得到提升。友方单位附近的敌人会持续被墨须伤害。%buff_duration%秒后将根据墨须对英雄造成伤害的时间对区域内单位造成伤害和眩晕。

shard_loc.en: Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal %shard_bonus_damage_pct%%% more damage and heal the target for %shard_heal_pct%%% of the damage Ink Swell deals.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard_loc.zh: 墨涌在施放时会驱散友方单位。墨涌造成的伤害增加%shard_bonus_damage_pct%%%，并且治疗目标，治疗量为墨涌造成伤害的%shard_heal_pct%%%。驱散类型：弱驱散

subject: gyrocopter_homing_missile
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target.
导弹发射后持续增加飞行速度，击中目标时造成伤害及眩晕。

context.description_en: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.
context.description_zh: 发射一枚会自动定位目标单位的追踪导弹。导弹发射后持续增加飞行速度，击中目标时造成伤害及眩晕。敌方单位可在导弹接近前将其击落。
notes_en: Towers do half damage to the missile.
The crosshair effect is visible to allies only.
The missile will follow and hit invisible units.
notes_zh: 防御塔对导弹造成半额伤害。
准星效果仅对队友可见。
导弹会跟随并击中隐身单位。

shard_loc.en: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a %shard_radius% area of effect after %shard_delay% second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.
shard_loc.zh: 追踪导弹现在从施放%shard_delay%秒后开始不断发射%shard_radius%作用范围的火箭弹幕。火箭弹幕优先以追踪导弹的目标为目标。

subject: invoker_cold_snap
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.

game_file_fields.AbilityBehavior: DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_HIDDEN | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NOT_LEARNABLE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_BACKSWING | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_SHOW_IN_GUIDES | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_DIRECT_KEYBIND

context.description_en: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of Quas. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of Quas.
context.description_zh: 祈求者将敌人的热量抽空，将其降到绝对零度，持续时间取决于冰元素等级。敌人将受到伤害并被短暂冻结，后续攻击会使敌人再次冻结并造成额外伤害。被冻结的频率固定，但是冻结的冷却时间将会随着冰元素等级提高而缩短。
notes_en: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.
notes_zh: 只有%damage_trigger%点以上的实际伤害才能触发急速冷却。

subject: kez_kazurai_katana
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 如果从背后刺中目标，目标会被眩晕。
If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned.

context.description_en: Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time. Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
context.description_zh: 长刀的攻击和技能会对敌人施加一个可叠加的持续伤害效果，持续时间内造成原攻击伤害一定百分比的额外伤害。凯可以主动使用技能，刺中目标，阻止他们移动或转身。目标身上的影武长刀效果爆发，使部分叠加数值立刻造成伤害。

shard_loc.en: Kez lifesteals %lifesteal_pct%%% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.
shard_loc.zh: 刺中后凯能从当次攻击吸血%lifesteal_pct%%%。如果从背后刺中目标，目标会被眩晕。提升最大爆发叠加数值。

subject: kez_shodo_sai
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.
招架会产生更强的印记，造成额外眩晕和致命一击伤害。

game_file_fields.AbilityBehavior: DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_HIDDEN | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IMMEDIATE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_BACKSWING | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_DONT_CANCEL_MOVEMENT | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_SHOW_IN_GUIDES | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_DIRECT_KEYBIND

context.description_en: Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
context.description_zh: 装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被缴械，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续%parry_duration%秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被眩晕%parry_stun_duration%秒并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被眩晕。子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。

shard_loc.en: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.
shard_loc.zh: 招架会产生更强的印记，造成额外眩晕和致命一击伤害。

subject: largo_frogstomp
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 他们每%stomp_interval%秒都会践踏地面，造成伤害和短暂眩晕并且区域内敌人的移动速度会被减缓。

context.description_en: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every %stomp_interval% second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.
context.description_zh: 朗戈把小青蛙扔到一片区域。他们每%stomp_interval%秒都会践踏地面，造成伤害和短暂眩晕并且区域内敌人的移动速度会被减缓。

subject: leshrac_split_earth
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 造成伤害和短暂的眩晕。
Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.

context.description_en: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.
context.description_zh: 撕裂敌人脚下的大地。造成伤害和短暂的眩晕。
notes_en: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
There is a %delay% second delay before the effect is applied.
notes_zh: 撕裂大地将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
技能经过%delay%秒延迟后生效。

shard_loc.en: Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location %shard_max_count% additional times, with a %shard_secondary_delay% second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by %shard_radius_increase%. Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.
shard_loc.zh: 撕裂大地在相同地点再重复%shard_max_count%次，重复间隔为%shard_secondary_delay%秒。每次作用范围增加%shard_radius_increase%。撕裂大地的重复地点对双方队伍可见。
